705310101.text: Please wait! Are you also here for the King of Invokations Grand Prix?

705310102.text: If you have a minute, I'd like to tell you a little about this event hosted by the Adventurers' Guild called "A Tour of Wonders."

705310105.text: Thank you! Then I'll go ahead and introduce the basics of this event.

705310106.text: Simply put, the Adventurers' Guild has placed multiple Scenic Checkpoints in various locations across Mondstadt.

705310107.text: All you have to do is find these Scenic Checkpoints and mark your Sightseeing Handbook with the commemorative stamps at each location.

705310108.text: The challenge will be considered completed once you find every Scenic Checkpoint and collect all the stamps.

705310109.text: Sure sounds like something the Adventurers' Guild would host.

705310110.text: Hehe... We put a lot of thought into the placement of these Scenic Checkpoints.

705310111.text: However... some of them are located in remote areas, and I can't guarantee they're entirely clear of monsters.

705310112.text: But I'm sure that dealing with those monsters would be a walk in the park for someone as experienced as you.

705310113.text: And that's all from me! Here's your Sightseeing Handbook. Have fun!
